newsitem.title: JAPAN: S'tomo Corp sets up insurance broking arm.
newsitem.headline: S'tomo Corp sets up insurance broking arm.

text.p: Sumitomo Corp has set up a wholly owned insurance broking subsidiary, the first by a Japanese trading house in Japan, a Sumitomo spokesman said on Thursday.
Sumitomo Corp launched Bluewell Insurance Brokers Ltd in Tokyo on Wednesday with 30 million yen in capital, the spokesman said.
It is likely to start operations in mid-October, carrying out insurance broking with overseas insurance firms, marine hull insurance broking and reinsurance broking, the spokesman said.
The broking unit also aims to start a risk management consulting business in the future, he said.
The government eased regulations covering financial industries in April, allowing trading houses and other firms to become insurance brokers.
Sumitomo Corp has built up an international insurance broking network since 1990, launching units in Hong Kong, Britain and the United States, the spokesman said.
